name: agent_prompting_with_artifact_delivery_constraint
summary: Prompt pattern that explicitly specifies file paths, runnable output, and an explicit design document to be sent back as an inspectable attachment.
steps: Specify the target application type and core game/interaction mechanics
Instruct the agent to save code files into a dedicated target folder (/agent/mushroom-jump.app)
Require a short architecture/design note file explaining mechanics
Instruct the agent to return/attach the design note file upon completion for immediate review
jarvis_use: Structure task prompts to Jarvis so generated summaries or config files are emitted as distinct attached file handles rather than raw wall-of-text.

name: inline_chat_artifact_click_to_dock
summary: Clicking an inline file attachment card inside an agent chat message immediately docks and renders it in a side inspection pane without reloading the page.
steps: Agent completes file generation and emits a file card component (DESIGN_NOTE.md) in the chat response
User clicks the attachment card
UI expands or targets the right-side split pane and renders the document (e.g. formatted markdown)
Conversation history remains pinned and interactive in the center pane
jarvis_use: Allow clicking any generated artifact in Jarvis chat to slide open a QuickLook or markdown viewer pane on the right.

name: tabbed_workbench_panel_mode_switching
summary: Right-hand inspector panel supports switching context between file views, local web views, remote browsers, and git diffs.
steps: Click the panel header tab dropdown menu
Select among available integrated tools (Files, Local Browser, Terminal, Cloud Browser, Git)
Panel updates context to the chosen tool while preserving the agent chat state in the primary view
jarvis_use: Provide a unified secondary drawer in Jarvis desktop UI that flips between DOM preview, diff inspector, and file viewer.

name: port_discovery_local_browser_preview
summary: Embedded browser pane scans sandbox listening ports and provides one-click launch of local web server previews.
steps: Agent launches background web dev server (e.g. Node/Python on port 3000)
Workbench detects bound port and populates the 'Open Ports' list (http://localhost:3000)
User clicks the port entry to mount an interactive webview session
Directly interact with and verify the web application (e.g. canvas controls, responsiveness)
jarvis_use: Expose local ports spawned by Jarvis development scripts directly in an embedded WebKit webview for automated or manual verification.

name: collapsible_bottom_panel_tool_docking
summary: Docking utility tools into a collapsible bottom drawer to keep both conversational context and side preview visible simultaneously.
steps: Click 'Show bottom panel' toggle button in the top right header
Select an available tool from the bottom drawer launchpad (e.g., Terminal, Files, Git)
Bottom panel opens docked under the chat without covering the center dialogue or the right preview panel
jarvis_use: Use a bottom dock drawer in Jarvis operator console for long-running CLI tails and background task logs.

name: sandboxed_terminal_verification_command
summary: Chaining directory navigation, file listing, and HTTP header checking to verify container server health without opening an external shell.
steps: Attach to interactive sandbox shell in the docked terminal
Execute chained bash command: cd /agent/mushroom-jump.app && ls -la && curl -I http://localhost:3000
Inspect directory contents, permissions, and HTTP response headers (HTTP/1.1 200 OK, Content-Type)
jarvis_use: Run piped health check commands (ls -la && curl -I) in sub-agent sandboxes before reporting task completion.

name: autonomous_verification_script_fallback
summary: Self-correcting agent execution flow that recovers from missing helper scripts by verifying services directly.
steps: Agent checks sandbox documentation for preview URL checker script (/agent/scripts/check-preview-url.mjs)
Detect that the referenced helper script does not exist in the environment
Bypass missing script by launching the development server directly
Verify the exposed endpoint and extract the preview URL autonomously
jarvis_use: Equip Jarvis sub-agents with fallback paths so that missing ecosystem helper scripts do not abort pipeline execution.
